analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md, adding documentation (head lines 1059-1072 per the patch) about SDK 27.2 Date-comparison and weak-import release checks. The supplied units are head_text excerpts at lines 1383-2296, which sit outside the changed range, so I treated them as unchanged surrounding documentation. They cover Gemma/MiMo tensor-parallel tests, release pipeline tests, the SSD write budget, Flint and Nemotron qualification, and other test descriptions. The excerpts describe tests only and change no runtime behavior, authorization, encryption, attestation, key custody or cache handling. The SSD cache test mentions (lines 1869-1876) restate existing controls: encrypted accounting, owner-only permissions and no fallback. They do not alter T-041 behavior (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, KEK purge). The release test text at lines 1779-1851 states that signing uses Developer ID with no ad-hoc signing and that dev-branch publication is restricted. It documents existing CI constraints and weakens none. The new script references (check-date-comparisons.py, check-provider-weak-imports.py) were not supplied, so their contents are unverified. This is a documentation contract only, not evidence of a regression. No threat-model assumption is invalidated. Integration needs no cross-file follow-up beyond confirming that the referenced scripts exist and are wired into Release Integrity as described.
